title: Television: Wings on Top Of The Pops | 1974
content:
Wings filmed an appearance on the BBC’s Top Of The Pops on 20 November 1974.

They performed ‘Junior’s Farm’, which had been released as a UK single the previous month.

The show was filmed in Studio Two at BBC Television Centre in London’s White City. Wings lip-synced to ‘Junior’s Farm’, and also mimed backing vocals for David Essex’s single ‘Gonna Make You A Star. The episode was broadcast the following evening.
